mechanism: Keep existing32-way packed FFT passes and <=1024-Pair expanded Vec leaves. Replace nested parallel fused leaf execution with bounded binary forks down to a serial butterfly leaf. Compute one power-of-two cutoff per transform: floor_power_of_two(clamp(vector_count/(2*workers),64,1024)). Carry it through recursion. Terminal leaves use existing DIF/DIT quad/within arithmetic without Rayon operations.
purpose: Reduce nested task/synchronization work and suspended expanded-buffer lifetimes, while exposing >=2*workers chunks when vector_count>=128*workers. Benefit is a hypothesis; full supplied-shape latency and CPU profiles decide.
activation: Private cfg zopro_serial_fft_leaves and explicit ZOPRO_CPU_SERIAL_FFT_LEAVES=1 sampled once per process; absent/0 OFF. Original disabled function body retained with an entry dispatch. No FFT pass-grain or private Rayon scheduler change is included.
memory: Same packed representation, cached roots,32-way passes and expanded <=1024Pair Vec allocation/collect/store/drop. No new buffer, key table, plan, copy, dependency or per-proof heap allocation. Additional binary fork frames have fixed references/scalars; no large stack arrays. Scheduling still needs actual pressure/concurrency qualification.
